title: ‘Jean Aunty’ chased away from Suresh Sallay’s protest at Fort
summary: Jean Aunty, an Aragalaya activist, was chased away from the satyagraha held near the Fort Railway Station in Colombo against the detention of former State Intelligence Service (SIS) Director, Major General (Retired) Suresh Sallay.

title: Houthis say they’ll block Israeli sailing in Red Sea
summary: The Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen take responsibility for this morning’s missile attack on central Israel, as well as announcing that they will block “Israeli maritime navigation in the Red Sea.”

title: Vehicle owners to receive SMS alerts on number plates
summary: The printing of vehicle number plates, which had been suspended for more than a year, resumed today at the Department of Motor Traffic (DMT) premises in Werahera under the patronage of Deputy Minister of Transport and Highways Prasanna Gunasena.

title: Trump calls on Iran and Israel to stop ‘shooting immediately’
summary: US President Donald Trump has called on both Israel and Iran to stop attacking each other.

title: Kananathan pitches global investment vision to Kerala’s new Chief Minister
summary: Former diplomat Kananathan held consultations with Kerala Chief Minister VD Menon Satheesan, the veteran and senior politician who was elected as the Chief Minister two weeks ago, at the Chief Minister’s Office inThiruvananthapuram this morning.

title: Kirsten revolution begins with Kamindu
summary: Gary Kirsten’s tenure as Sri Lanka head coach was off to a flying start when Kusal Mendis and Co. set up a comfortable victory over the West Indies in the opening ODI match last week.

title: Three Sri Lankans held hostage in Ethiopia rescued
summary: Three Sri Lankan nationals who had been held hostage by an organised criminal gang in Ethiopia have been rescued, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said.

title: China’s Xi Jinping arrives in North Korea for rare summit with Kim Jong Un
summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping received a pomp-filled welcome as he arrived in North Korea Monday for his first visit to the secluded nation in seven years.

title: Sallay continues treatment at Colombo National Hospital
summary: Former State Intelligence Service (SIS) Director Major General (Retired) Suresh Sallay, who was admitted to the Colombo National Hospital while being held in remand custody under a detention order, continues to receive treatment, according to hospital sources.

title: Dengue surge alarms authorities as cases jump by up to 40%
summary: Health authorities have raised concern over a sharp rise in dengue infections across the country, as confirmed cases this year climbed to 35,228, marking an increase of around 30% to 40% compared to the same period last year.

title: Ten dead after migrant boat capsizes near Malta, Italian coastguard says
summary: At least 10 people have died after a boat thought to be carrying migrants capsized near Malta, the Italian coast guard has said.

title: Death toll in Philippine quake rises to at least 15
summary: The death toll from a magnitude 7.8 earthquake in the southern Philippines has reached at least 15, with more than 100 people injured, disaster agency officials said.

title: Opposition protest over detention of Suresh Sallay
summary: A protest organised by several opposition political parties is currently underway near the Fort Railway Station in Colombo, condemning what participants describe as the inhumane and unjust treatment of former State Intelligence Service (SIS) Director, Major General (Retired) Suresh Sallay.

title: Vehicle imports remain steady despite surcharge: Customs
summary: Sri Lanka Customs says vehicle imports have not declined significantly despite the surcharge imposed earlier this year, with imports continuing to contribute substantially to state revenue.

title: Tamim Iqbal becomes new BCB president
summary: Former Bangladesh captain Tamim Iqbal has taken charge of the country’s cricket administration after being elected the new president of the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB), marking a significant new chapter in his association with the sport.
